def _correct_lut_descriptor(element):
    """Correct the LUT Descriptor values when the VR is SS.

    The first and third values of LUT Descriptor (0028,3002) and the
    Red/Green/Blue Palette Color Lookup Table Descriptor are always
    unsigned (US), even when the VR is SS due to the second value being
    signed (as indicated by Pixel Representation).
    """
    if element.VR != 'SS':
        return

    # Mask to unsigned 16-bit
    values = list(element.value)
    if len(values) >= 1:
        values[0] = values[0] & 0xFFFF
    if len(values) >= 3:
        values[2] = values[2] & 0xFFFF
    element.value = values
